title: Ergodic Deviation-Robust Equilibrium under Mirror Descent Learning in Finite Games
summary: We introduce Ergodic Deviation-Robust Equilibrium (EDRE), a dynamics-relative equilibrium concept for repeated finite games in which agents learn via entropic mirror descent (EMD).
